question: Why does the Haber–Bosch process, as described in the lithium-mediated ammonia review, run at pressures of only 1-5 atm?
rendered: The document does not state that the Haber–Bosch process runs at pressures of only 1-5 atm. It actually states that the Haber–Bosch process "catalytically combines N2 and H2 under extreme temperatures (400–650 °C) and pressures (200–400 atm)."
